subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Lousy
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lousy"** means something that is very poor or bad in quality. (बेकार)

 
 
• **Example:** The service at the restaurant was** lousy**, and the food was even worse.
 
 
 
• **"Pitiful"** refers to something that deserves or arouses pity, often due to its poor quality or condition. (दयनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** The **pitiful **state of the old house made it clear that it had been abandoned for years.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'lousy'** is **'pitiful'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Funny** (मज़ेदार): Causing laughter or amusement.

 
 
• **Example:** The comedian's jokes were very** funny** and had everyone laughing.
 
 
 
• **Moral** (नैतिक): Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** The story had a strong **moral** lesson about the importance of honesty.
 
 
 
• **Praiseworthy** (प्रशंसनीय): Deserving approval and admiration.
 
 
• **Example:** Her efforts to help the homeless are truly **praiseworthy.**
